title: Bug Fixes and OAuth Improvements
description: Fixed a regression with OAuth integration for some MCP servers and improved reliability of Devin Cloud connections in Windsurf.

title: CLI Debug Mode and /btw Support
description: Cursor CLI added Debug Mode for finding root causes of difficult bugs, /btw command for sidebar questions without stopping execution, interactive /config menu for model selection and runtime preferences, and custom /statusline for session metadata display.

title: Continue v1.3.38 - Config and Filtering Enhancements
description: Added .continue/configs support for configuration management, filter session history by workspace directory, and multiple fixes including ensuring config.yaml exists when accessed. Includes dependency updates and various improvements.

title: Agents Window Tiled Layout and Upgraded Voice Input
description: Cursor 3 Agents Window now supports tiled layouts for running multiple agents in parallel, upgraded voice input with batch STT for higher quality, branch selection in empty state, navigate to files from diff, and file search filters.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Design Launch
description: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.7, their latest model with improvements in software engineering, complex coding tasks, and better vision capabilities. Alongside this, they introduced Claude Design, an Anthropic Labs product for collaborating on visual outputs like designs, prototypes, and slides.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Opus 4.7 is a serious regression, not an upgrade
horrible at writing, sloppy, unprecise, very empty sentences
4.7 seems pretty good about clarifying things compared to 4.6
4.7 seems better primarily because 4.6 had degraded in quality before the update

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Generally Available
description: Claude Opus 4.7 is now generally available in GitHub Copilot, bringing the latest model improvements to Copilot users including better software engineering and vision capabilities.

title: Windsurf 2.0 with Devin Cloud Integration
description: Major Windsurf 2.0 release featuring Devin cloud agent available directly inside Windsurf, new Kanban-style Agent Command Center for managing all sessions, refined Windsurf Browser with Cascade tool, and improved .gitignore/.codeiumignore handling.

community_feedback.quote: I was skeptical of Devin after the launch, but it's been writing most of my code the last few months.

title: Aider v0.86.0 - GPT-5 Support and New Models
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models, Grok-4 via xAI and OpenRouter, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, and MoonshotAI Kimi K2. Enhanced /clear and /undo commands, and improved model settings handling. Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.

title: Model Selection for Claude and Codex Agents
description: Users can now select models for Claude and Codex agents on github.com, providing flexibility in choosing the appropriate AI model for different tasks.

title: Copilot Data Residency and FedRAMP Compliance
description: GitHub Copilot now offers data residency in US + EU and FedRAMP compliance, addressing regulatory and data protection requirements for enterprise customers.

title: Continue v1.3.36 - JetBrains Fixes and ClawRouter Provider
description: Resolved critical security vulnerabilities, fixed JetBrains remote config sync to prevent IDE freezes, added ClawRouter as a provider for cost-optimized model routing. Includes multiple crash fixes and memory leak prevention.

title: Bugbot Learned Rules and MCP Support
description: Bugbot can now learn from feedback on pull requests and turn those signals into learned rules that improve future reviews. Also added MCP support, allowing Bugbot to access MCP servers for additional context during code reviews.

title: Claude Cowork Generally Available
description: Claude Cowork is now generally available on macOS and Windows with new capabilities including role-based access controls for Enterprise plans. Admins can organize users into groups and assign custom roles defining which Claude capabilities members can use.

title: Fixed Adaptive Model Router Bug
description: Fixed a bug with the adaptive model router which prevented switching models after the first request. All users who encountered the bug had quota reset and overage restored.

title: Aider v0.85.0 - Gemini 2.5 and Responses API
description: Added support for Gemini 2.5 Pro, Flash, and preview models with thinking tokens. Support for Responses API models like o1-pro and o3-pro. Enhanced thinking tokens support, commit language options, and added MATLAB and Clojure repository map support.

title: Adaptive Model Router and Pricing Visibility
description: Introduced Adaptive model router that intelligently selects the best model for each task. Updated model picker with token pricing information, prompt cache timer, and token counts in response cards.

title: Adaptive Model Router Launch
description: New Adaptive model option available in the model picker that intelligently selects the best model for each task, helping users make their quota last longer by avoiding overuse of premium models.
